action: Run week 3 Financial Triage Navigator sessions and compile first utilization report, lock in Nicole Washington for community center table event, formalize written referral coordination with Auto Tech Pipeline, send Santos utilization data
narrative: Lisa Freeman ran the third week of Financial Triage Navigator sessions and compiled the first utilization report: 14 total sessions conducted since launch, 11 participants left with a specific prioritized next step, 6 referred to Kevin O'Brien's office hours, 4 referred to retraining programs, 3 referred to the community college pathway, and 4 presented needs no existing Millfield resource currently addresses — the unmet-needs category she will use in every future funding conversation. Nicole Washington agreed to sit at a corner table during the next Community Connection Night for drop-in conversations about healthcare credential pathways, a concrete bounded ask she accepted without hesitation. Mark Thompson contacted Lisa the same day the board voted yes on his program, and together they drafted a one-paragraph written description of how the Auto Tech Pipeline and the Financial Triage Navigator cross-refer the same population — now printed in both organizations' handout materials. Lisa sent Santos the utilization aggregate counts with a single-paragraph cover note; Santos responded the same day acknowledging the report and asking Lisa to flag the unmet-needs category at the next task force session.
